title: Scientific Engineering Institute passes to Searle, then Monsanto
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Scientific Engineering Institute passes to Searle, then Monsanto, about late 1970s-1985 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: CIA's Scientific Engineering Institute was quietly transitioned into the private sector in the late 1970s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the Scientific Engineering Institute, a research outfit belonging to the CIA (the US spy agency), was quietly moved into private hands in the late 1970s. As he tells it, it passed to the drug company Searle and then to the company Monsanto by 1985, and he ties the story to Donald Rumsfeld, which if true would mean secret government research carried on inside private industry.
